title: Original Wordle lexicon record
description: The schema for one line of data/wordle-lexicon.jsonl. Each record describes one word from the original 12,972-word legal-guess vocabulary.

is_original_answer.description: Whether the word belongs to the original 2,315-word answer vocabulary.

zipf_frequency.description: The wordfreq Zipf frequency for English. Higher values indicate more common words; null means that no frequency was recorded.

parts_of_speech.description: The lexical parts of speech reported by the first matching source. An empty array means that none of the configured sources classified the word.
